messages:
alice (infra): Heads up — we're scheduling a compact/slimdown maintenance for parts of the GPU fleet next Thu 02:00–08:00 UTC. This is a rolling node drain + graceful reboot + compact placement to free underutilized racks. No config changes to models.
ben (sre): Which pools/regions are hit?
alice (infra): Primary targets: us-west1-saturn, eu-central-gradient, and a few edge racks in apac-west1. We'll do cohorts to avoid capacity cliff.
miguel (oncall): ETA for each cohort? customer impact?
alice (infra): Cohorts ~30 racks each, 2hr window per cohort (evac 20m, reboot 30–40m, backfill/kv-seed ~30m). We expect transient queueing; latency SLOs should hold. No planned customer-facing downtime.
karen (network): We'll be briefly reprogramming egress QoS on a subset during drain — I'll post ACL snippets.
alice (infra): TL;DR plan:
```
- start Thu 02:00 UTC
- us-west1: cohorts A,B (02:00–06:00)
- eu-central: cohorts C (04:00–06:00)
- apac-west1 edge: small window 06:00–08:00 (low traffic)
- backfill and KV seed follow cohort completion
```
ben (sre): Can we limit backfill to burst capacity policy? We don't want big $$ spikes.
alice (infra): Yes — backfill uses reserved burst pool cap of 15% per-region. Cost impact estimate: ~$4.5k for the maintenance (short-lived).
raj (prod-eng): Any feature flags or rollout hooks we should flip? Some teams rely on low-latency tail.
miguel (oncall): @raj please nominate 2 critical routes; we'll pin them to non-evac hosts during your flagged windows.
raj (prod-eng): I'll open a short PR listing prod-critical routes.
ops-bot: Reminder: run `./ops/healthcheck.sh --pre` 30m before start and `--post` after cohort done.
ben (sre): Network note: if egress QoS reattach takes >5m, we'll pause cohort.
karen (network): Agree. We'll monitor BGP and egress counters. I'll add a dashboard panel for per-cohort egress.
alice (infra): Evac command sequence (short):
```
1) cordon --cohort <id>
2) drain --grace 1200 --evict-bulk
3) monitor tasks in `fleet-ui` / `task-tracker`
4) reboot nodes sequentially (rate 4/rack)
5) uncordon & kv-seed
```
miguel (oncall): What rollback looks like?
alice (infra): If we see >3% job failures or error-rate spike >2x baseline for 5m, abort and rehydrate from snapshot, revert QoS, and move leftover tasks to warm pools.
ben (sre): Do we need to pre-warm KV cache? Past runs had cold-cache latency blips.
alice (infra): We'll seed top-20 prefixes proactively for each cohort; script attached below.
```
./scripts/kv_seed.sh --cohort A --prefix-list /ops/prefixes/top20.json
```
raj (prod-eng): Can we flag certain tenants as exempt? Low-latency paying customers might need exclusion.
alice (infra): Exempt list accepted, but capacity accounting will be strict. Exempt nodes = reduced backfill headroom.
miguel (oncall): Who's the primary comms owner during the window?
alice (infra): ben will be primary on-call, miguel secondary, karen for net, raj for product escalations.
ben (sre): I'll own the incident channel and post periodic cadence updates every 15m.
support-bot: Scheduled maintenance ticket created: #MNT-2026-187. Customer-facing banner set to: "We are performing infrastructure maintenance; you may see small latency changes."
ben (sre): Quick checklist for start (I will check off live): pre-health, snapshot, announce to customers, lock bursts, run pre-kv seed.
karen (network): I'll push QoS ACLs in staged mode and test with a canary before cohort A.
alice (infra): One risk item: apac edge racks have older BMC; we will skip auto-reboot if BMC responds slowly, fall back to manual handoff. That costs time but reduces flaps.
miguel (oncall): Acknowledged. If apac edge slow, we'll extend maintenance window and keep customers notified.
raj (prod-eng): Anything else I should share with PMs? Short note: no API changes, minor perf fluctuations expected, targeted start time.
alice (infra): Perfect. I'll post final runbook and the cohort mapping in this thread 24h before.
ben (sre): Thanks — I'll prepare the cadence messages and Ops channel. :thumbsup: 
ops-bot: Preflight checks scheduled for 2026-03-25T01:30:00Z.
alice (infra): Closing — flag if you need cohort reassignment.
